notes: Kien truc moi cho notification lien quan violation (thay the muc tieu auto-navigate+highlight cua 1.43.4/1.43.5 - dung nhung khong dat UX mong muon theo quyet dinh cua nguoi dung). 'Xem loi' gio MO MODAL chi tiet thay vi tu dieu huong: doc lai dung state hien tai qua API moi getChecklistViolationDetail(violationIds) (lib/checklist-tasks.js, dat canh getChecklistTaskHistory() de tai dung actor/isSubject/isCreator/sameActor - KHONG tao permission engine moi; nhan vien luon xem duoc loi cua chinh minh du khong co Checklist grant nao, dung nguyen tac 'quyen nen ca nhan' da ap dung cho ownAssignment). Ho tro nhieu violation id trong 1 notification (hien danh sach, khong silently drop lỗi thieu quyen - deniedCount rieng). Modal READ-ONLY hoan toan (khong xac nhan/giai trinh/huy/sua) - cuoi modal co CTA dieu huong theo dung capability that (canViewViolations/canRecordViolation tu roleWorkspaceState.data, KHONG hard-code role label): 'Di toi xu ly' (nhan vien/khong co quyen Nhat ky loi, tai dung focus=violation&violation_id= deep-link cua 1.43.4/1.43.5 cho Phieu cua toi) hoac 'Di toi Nhat ky loi' (co quyen) - Nhat ky loi gio tu mo dung modal chi tiet DA CO SAN (openViolationLogDetail/violationLogDetailHtml, day du lich su/minh chung) khi tai xong dung pham vi quyen va tim thay ban ghi, khong tao modal thu hai. EXPLANATION_SUBMITTED doi subject_id tu task.id sang task.violation_id de thong nhat contract voi VIOLATION_CREATED (subject_id luon la violation id). Notification cu (subjectType/subjectId kieu truoc batch nay) roi ve fallback dieu huong cu, khong crash. Khong doi permission/score-engine/workflow/SQL/migration. Test moi: scripts/test-checklist-violation-detail-permission.js (14 check, mock Supabase that su ap dung filter - proof khong leak) + mo rong scripts/test-checklist-actionable-notifications-ui.js (modal state/multi-violation/destination routing/Nhat ky lỗi auto-open).
